title: Let clients choose “last day of the month” as their collection day
text: Brokers want debit-order and payroll clients to be able to choose the last day of the month as their collection day instead of days 1 to 28.
findings: Does last day mean the last calendar day or the last business day for collection?
Existing contracts with collection day 29, 30 or 31 are not mentioned: should they be converted?
The collection day validation rule limits recurring monthly methods to days 1 to 28 and must change.
No acceptance criteria for February in a leap year.

title: Block activation when the premium is zero
text: A contract must never be activated if the calculated premium is zero or negative. The user must see which benefit caused it.
findings: The message shown to the agent is not specified.
It is unclear whether a zero premium is allowed for promotional campaigns.

title: Make onboarding faster
text: Onboarding a new client takes too long. Make it quicker and easier for the sales team.
findings: No measurable target: how long is too long, and how fast is fast enough?
Which step of the process is slow is not stated: capturing the client, linking benefits or validation?
No definition of easier for the sales team.
